episodes.transcript:
Alder Bay runs a parcel locker trial at its public library for residents collecting deliveries. The town assigns each parcel a collection code that residents enter at the locker door. The library staff place parcels into empty lockers and send collection codes to the intended residents.

Residents can collect their parcels during library opening hours without waiting for a staffed delivery desk. The town pays for locker maintenance while the library provides space for the trial equipment. Library staff check empty compartments each morning and report broken doors to the maintenance team.

The trial report records missed collections and resident feedback but does not estimate wider economic benefits. The town will review the recorded collection problems before deciding whether to extend the locker trial.
